articles.title: Scientists Made a Mini Black Hole Out of Light!
articles.summary: Imagine a black hole so tiny it fits on a table! Physicists used light to create one and saw it glow, just like Stephen Hawking predicted. They even watched it lose energy, like a real black hole slowly disappearing.

articles.title: Ice Cream Secrets: From Emperors to Giant Scoops!
articles.summary: Did you know ice cream was first enjoyed by Chinese emperors? Or that a single scoop once weighed over 3,000 pounds? July is National Ice Cream Month, and we've got the coolest facts, from ancient recipes to a $6,696 dessert!

articles.title: Welcome to Argentina: Land of Gauchos, Glaciers, and Giant Waterfalls!
articles.summary: Argentina is the second-largest country in South America, with cowboys called gauchos, the towering Andes, and Iguazú Falls—a waterfall so wide it stretches 1.6 miles! Nearly half the people live near Buenos Aires, the 'Paris of South America.'
